command: [UI] Enterprise Settings > Rollout > Rollout mode dropdown
purpose: Set the enterprise-wide rollout mode for declarative environments (Not enabled / Testing / Available / Enabled by default). Switches between Testing and Available are reversible; Enabled-by-default is permanent (requires Cognition admin to undo).

examples.expected_output: Org admins on classic now see migration callout; can self-service migrate

command: [UI] Enterprise Settings > Rollout > per-org table > opt org IN to blueprints
purpose: Switch a specific organization to declarative blueprints (Testing/Available mode). Overrides the enterprise default for that org.

examples.invocation: On Rollout page, find test-org, click opt-in
examples.scenario: Pilot a single org during Testing mode

command: [UI] Enterprise Settings > Rollout > per-org table > opt org OUT (back to classic)
purpose: Roll an org back to classic setup from blueprints. Configurations are preserved; takes effect on next session. Active sessions unaffected.

examples.invocation: Click 'switch to classic' on a specific org row

command: [UI] Settings > Devin's base environment > edit blueprint
purpose: Edit the enterprise-tier blueprint (initialize/maintenance/knowledge sections). Saved changes trigger an enterprise-wide rebuild across all orgs.

examples.invocation: Settings > Devin's base environment > edit > add Python 3.12 install > save
examples.scenario: Standardize on Python 3.12 across all orgs

command: [UI] Settings > Devin's base environment > Secrets tab
purpose: Manage enterprise-wide secrets. Available across all orgs/sessions. Requires ManageAccountResources permission.

examples.invocation: Settings > Devin's base environment > Secrets > Add 'CORP_PROXY_TOKEN'
examples.expected_output: Secret available enterprise-wide on next build

command: [UI] Enterprise Settings > Roles > Create a custom role
purpose: Create a custom org-level or account-level role with selected permissions. Requires Manage Account Membership permission. Both Organization-level and Enterprise-level role types supported.

examples.invocation: Enterprise Settings > Roles > Create a custom role > scope=Org > name='ReadOnlyAuditor' > permissions=[ViewSessions,ViewMetrics]

command: [UI] Enterprise Settings > Enterprise members > Assign account-level role
purpose: Assign an account-level (enterprise-wide) role to a user. Account-level roles inherit corresponding org-level permissions in every org. Requires Manage Account Membership.

examples.invocation: Enterprise Settings > Enterprise members > <user> > set role=Admin
examples.expected_output: User has full enterprise admin access

command: [UI] Org Settings > Organization members > Assign organization-level role
purpose: Assign an org-level role within a specific organization. Requires Manage Organization Membership permission.

examples.invocation: Org Settings > Organization members > <user> > set role=Admin

command: [UI] Enterprise Settings > Members > Configure IdP group mappings
purpose: Map IdP group names to Devin roles for SSO auto-assignment. SSO provider must send `groups` array in the assertion.

flags.name: idp-group
flags.doc: IdP group name from SSO assertion.

examples.invocation: Enterprise Settings > Members > IdP groups > map 'eng-leadership' → Admin
examples.expected_output: All members of that group get Admin on next SSO login

command: [UI] Enterprise Settings > Rollout > per-org table > filter dropdown
purpose: Filter the per-org table by All / Blueprints / Classic / Overrides. Used to find unmigrated orgs during phased rollout.

examples.expected_output: Only orgs still on classic setup

command: [UI] Settings > Devin's base environment > trigger enterprise-wide rebuild
purpose: Cascade a fresh build across ALL organizations. Used after enterprise-blueprint update or enterprise-secret rotation.

examples.invocation: After updating enterprise blueprint, click 'Rebuild all'
examples.expected_output: All orgs rebuild in their queue order

command: Email enterprise@cognition.ai for Customer Dedicated Deployment setup
purpose: Initiate Customer Dedicated Deployment setup. Cognition Enterprise Sales handles networking discussion (PrivateLink vs IPSec, customer VPC topology).

examples.invocation: Email enterprise@cognition.ai with intended VPC topology and SCM/artifact endpoints
examples.scenario: Self-hosted SCM org ready to start dedicated deployment
